name: Herod Agrippa I
bio: Herod (Agrippa I), grandson of Herod the Great, persecuted the church, killing James the brother of John with the sword and, seeing this pleased the Jews, arresting Peter and imprisoning him intending to bring him out for trial after the Passover. When Peter was miraculously freed by an angel, Herod had the guards executed for failing to keep him. Later, while receiving the acclaim of the people of Tyre and Sidon as though he were a god, without giving glory to God, an angel of the Lord struck him, and he was eaten by worms and died (Acts 12:1-23). He is a different figure from his son, Herod Agrippa II, who later heard Paul's defense before Festus.
